findings.text: The comment sets a policy of 600 seconds for the other host tests plus time for collection and reporting, but no test links that policy to `host_nix_limit`: `test_host_nix_limit_allows_every_dev_loop_phase` only checks that the limit is more than the 2520 seconds of the dev loop, so a limit of 2521 still passes. Fix: name the 600-second allowance, for example as a constant in `tests/test_recipe_limits.py` with a docstring, and assert that `host_nix_limit` is at least the dev-loop sum plus that allowance, or remove the 600-second claim from the comment.
